fields.Name: W1 -> C3.2
fields.Description: Gate G7.7 (owner PR 5 B4, phase 7, datasets W1 and C1, criterion C3.2): only random search is enabled on W1-signal and C1; enabling bayesian without a passing equal-cost comparison (LowerBoundMin > 0 across W1-signal and C1) is refused by both the protocol Validate() and the orchestrator, 1 of 1. Also verifies that every writer of Passed (GraphQL create, GraphQL update, Update Record action) computes Passed = LowerBoundMin > 0 and refuses client attempts to forge Passed = 1 when LowerBoundMin <= 0.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Bayesian guided search without a passing equal-cost comparison is refused, and Passed cannot be forced true by any writer when LowerBoundMin <= 0.
